title: Keep bound integers through UNNEST and ARRAY_AGG
summary: H2 returned the bound integers instead of two nulls. Aggregate and scalar queries agreed after rebinding the same statements, including duplicate 7 and a later negative value.

change.description: Derive the array element type during preparation without replacing values that will arrive at execution.

notes: The scalar-row query independently exposes the current bindings. Changing both values detects a result frozen at prepare time or cached on reuse.
With identical compiled caller bytes, 2.2.224 matched the parent and 2.3.230 matched the landing on all three histories.
